source_record_subset.pg: SELECT "t2"."name" FROM "match" AS "t1" INNER JOIN "league" AS "t2" ON "t1"."league_id" = "t2"."id" WHERE "t1"."season" = '2015/2016' GROUP BY "t2"."name" ORDER BY SUM( "t1"."home_team_goal" + "t1"."away_team_goal" ) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
source_record_subset.cracksql: SELECT `t2`.`name` FROM `match` AS `t1` INNER JOIN `league` AS `t2` ON `t1`.`league_id` = `t2`.`id` WHERE `t1`.`season` = '2015/2016' GROUP BY `t2`.`name` ORDER BY SUM(`t1`.`home_team_goal` + `t1`.`away_team_goal`) DESC LIMIT 1
